articles.summary: Parke Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: PKBK), the holding company for Parke Bank, today announced the appointment of prominent South Jersey and South Carolina entrepreneur Michael L. Regina to its Board of Directors. Regina brings more than two decades of business leadership, entrepreneurship, and commercial real estate development experience to the board. He is the co-founder and principal of Big Sky Enterprises, a commercial real estate development, design-build, and finance firm founded in 2003 based in South Jersey. Big Sky Enterprises manages and oversees real estate projects, project financing, and construction across commercial, medical, educational, and community sectors. In addition to his success with Big Sky Enterprises, Regina co-founded the Charleston, South Carolina based company Global Post Auditing Solutions in 2016, which specializes in auditing, cost recovery, and financial technology logistics. articles.summary: Parke Bancorp, Inc. (the "Company") (NASDAQ: PKBK) today announced the declaration of a $0.20 per share cash dividend, payable on October 16, 2026, to its stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 2, 2026. The Board anticipates paying cash dividends on a quarterly basis, subject to determination and declaration by the Board of Directors, which will take into account a number of factors, including the financial condition of the Company and the Bank, and any applicable legal and regulatory restrictions on the payment of dividends by the Company. If paid, such dividends may be reduced or eliminated in future periods. Parke Bancorp, Inc. was incorporated in January 2005, while Parke Bank commenced operations in January 1999. Parke Bancorp and Parke Bank maintain their principal offices at 601 Delsea Drive, Washington Township, New Jersey.
